svg.title: TOP258YN 150 W, 19 V power supply (Figure 42)
svg.desc: 150 W, 19 V flyback supply with the TOP258YN, redrawn from Figure 42 on page 22 of the TOP252-262 datasheet. A 250 to 380 volt DC input goes through fuse F1 and thermistor RT1 to the bus, with bulk capacitor C1 across it. Two 4.7 megohm resistors R6 and R7 in series from the bus, with 8.06 kilohm R3 to the negative rail, set the X pin. Two 2 megohm resistors R4 and R5 in series feed the V pin, which also takes the bias voltage through R19 and the 36 volt zener VR2. The primary winding of transformer T1 runs from the bus to the drain node. A clamp from the bus to the drain node has two P6KE100A suppressors in series, two 68 kilohm resistors and C3 in parallel, and the BYV26C diode D1. A snubber of three 1.5 kilohm resistors in series, diode D5 and 120 picofarad C18 also sits on the drain node. The TOP258YN has its S and F pins on the negative rail. The C pin has 100 nanofarad C11 to the negative rail and 6.8 ohm R10 in series with 47 microfarad C10, and the phototransistor U2B connects it to the bias node. A bias winding feeds that node through diode D4 and resistor R8, with 10 microfarad C9 to the winding's return. The secondary has two windings with a centre tap that is the RTN return. Each winding feeds a pair of MBR20100CT Schottky diodes with an RC snubber, and both land on the +19 volt rail. Y capacitor C4 goes from the bus to the centre tap. Output capacitors C5 to C8, inductor L1 and capacitors C15 and C16 filter the 19 volt, 7.7 amp output. Feedback: R16, R17 and R15 divide the output into a TL431, U3, whose cathode drives the LED of optocoupler U2A through R12 with C20, R24 and R11. A compensation network of R13, C12 and C13 runs from the TL431 cathode to the divider node. D6, R23 and C19 form a soft-finish branch.
